patterns: APPSC asks statement-pairs on niche electoral facts: floating constituency (Sangha, Sikkim), Sec. 80 vs 81 bar on questioning elections, national-party criteria, NETA app vs ECI.
Recurring single facts: Art. 326 adult suffrage, Art. 324 ECI, Art. 331 Anglo-Indians, delimitation freeze till 2026, four Delimitation Commissions, 1951-52 first election.
Traps APPSC uses: 'ink first used 1960 in Mysore' (false; 1962), MCC not enacted by Parliament, NOTA majority does not cancel poll.
FPTP vs PR conceptual items (voter-seat distortion, PR not needed in two-party system) appear in older UPSC sets.
App coverage is broad and sound; it adds 2026 delimitation-bill and Tamil Nadu resolution items and many A/R items that the exam rarely uses.
